newsitem.title: USA: CFC Intl says to buy Northern Bank Note.
newsitem.headline: CFC Intl says to buy Northern Bank Note.

text.p: Specialty chemical coating manufacturer CFC International Inc said Sunday that it agreed in principal to purchase Northern Bank Note Co of suburban Chicago, for a combination of cash, stock and notes.
Northern Bank Note is a financial security printer of stock certificates and intaglio printed documents, which provide protection against fraudulent duplication of documents, CFC said.
Net revenues in 1996 exceeded $4 million, CFC said.
Northern Bank Note operates a secure manufacturing facility with restricted access to a document storage system, CFC said.
This provides customers and auditors with the necessary paper trails to ensure backup and accuracy, CFC said.

In addition to bolstering CFC's security products business, the acquisition enhances Northern Bank Note's core business through CFC's larger sales force and by opening new international markets, CFC said.
